entities.name: Query aspartate-semialdehyde dehydrogenase
observations: 354 aa protein; predicted molecular mass 37.29 kDa, theoretical pI 4.61, and charge at pH 7 of −17.2.
Shows 46.6–47.1% identity over 96.3–96.6% query coverage to reviewed bacterial aspartate-semialdehyde dehydrogenases.
Contains Pfam Semialdhyde_dh (PF01118) at positions 11–122 and Semialdhyde_dhC (PF02774) at positions 151–337.
Function is assigned by strong homology as aspartate-semialdehyde dehydrogenase, EC 1.2.1.11; exact organism and experimental validation are unavailable from the sequence alone.

entities.name: Aspartate-semialdehyde dehydrogenase reaction
observations: Catalyzes reductive dephosphorylation of 4-phospho-L-aspartate to L-aspartate 4-semialdehyde using NADPH; Rhea RHEA:24284 and EC 1.2.1.11 are reported for close reviewed homologs.

entities.name: Aspartate-family amino acid biosynthesis
observations: The homologous enzyme functions in biosynthesis of lysine via the diaminopimelate pathway, methionine, and threonine; it catalyzes the second step from aspartate in these routes.
